decisive_items: A 55-year-old man with no significant medical history presented with a 10-month history of spontaneous, progressively painful umbilical discomfort
Biopsy of the umbilical lesion demonstrated a well-differentiated, infiltrating adenocarcinoma

Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT showed homogeneously enhancing umbilical tissue growth and irregular, circumferential thickening of the right third of the transverse colon measuring approximately 8.3 cm
response.rationale: R4 is more specific as it includes both the primary and metastatic sites of the cancer, while R1 only mentions the primary site

rejected.why: lacks information about the umbilical nodule and its relation to the colonic lesion
